# stapel-courses 0.1.0

Courses for a Stapel education product: Course -> Module -> Lesson (ordered, typed content blocks: text, video and attachments by opaque media id, embeds), enrollment with a lifecycle (pending, active, completed, expired, cancelled), a source (free, purchase, entitlement, staff grant) and an optional expiry, and an access gate per course chosen from a strategy registry (free, enrolled, purchased through stapel-orders, entitlement through stapel-billing). The outline names a lock reason for every lesson (sign in, enroll, buy, plan, drip date, previous lesson). Lesson progress is an idempotent upsert with a per-enrollment progress cache; drip by days since enrollment or by fixed date and a sequential-unlock switch pace a course. Quizzes on a lesson or module (single and multiple choice, true/false, short text) are graded on the server with attempt limits, a pass mark and a stored shuffle seed; answers never leave before submission. Completing every required lesson and quiz completes the course and issues a certificate with a public verification endpoint. A course is sold as orders purchasable type 'course' (resolver Function courses.purchasables); the order facts activate and cancel the enrollment. Courses never imports orders or billing.

Contract: axes 7 · surface 10 · extension points 10 · operations 39 · error codes 71 · flows 5.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- AUTHORING [enum, default "staff"] — Who creates courses
  staff (default): only staff create courses. members: any signed-in member creates and edits their own courses (a marketplace of teachers). Values: staff, members.
- CERTIFICATES [bool, default true] — Certificates
  true (default): completing a course issues a certificate with a public verification page. false: no certificates. Values: true, false.
- DEFAULT_ACCESS [enum, default "enrolled"] — Who can open a new course
  The access mode a new course starts with (each course can change it). free: anyone reads the lessons. enrolled (default): learners enroll for free, then read. purchased: learners buy the course through the shop first. entitlement: a paid plan includes it. Values: free, enrolled, purchased, entitlement.
- DEFAULT_DRIP [enum, default "none"] — Release lessons over time
  How a new course releases lessons. none (default): all at once. days: each lesson opens N days after the learner enrolls. date: each lesson opens on a fixed date. Values: none, days, date.
- DEFAULT_SEQUENTIAL [bool, default false] — Lessons in order
  false (default): learners open lessons in any order. true: a lesson opens only after every earlier required lesson is completed and its required quizzes are passed. Values: true, false.
- ENROLLMENT_REQUIRES_ACCOUNT [bool, default true] — Guests can learn
  true (default): a guest must sign in to enroll, save progress or take a quiz. false: guests can, and their progress moves to the account when they sign in. Values: true, false.
- PURCHASE_ACTIVATION [enum, default "paid"] — When a bought course opens
  paid (default): when the order is paid. confirmed: also when staff confirm an order by hand (shops without online payment). placed: as soon as the order is placed. Values: paid, confirmed, placed.

## Usage surface — call these before writing your own
This is the answer to "does Stapel already have something for X?". `instead of` names the outside symbol this one displaces.
### gate_function
- attachment_block — stapel_courses.blocks.attachment_block
  Built-in validator of an attachment block (opaque media_id, file name).
- clean_blocks — stapel_courses.blocks.clean_blocks
  Validate a lesson's blocks list with the registry; raises BlockInvalid carrying the index and a machine reason. Use it instead of storing author JSON unchecked.
- embed_block — stapel_courses.blocks.embed_block
  Built-in validator of an embed block (https URL, host in EMBED_HOSTS when set).
- text_block — stapel_courses.blocks.text_block
  Built-in validator of a text block (text, format markdown|plain).
- video_block — stapel_courses.blocks.video_block
  Built-in validator of a video block (opaque media_id, caption).
### predicate
- block_type_paths — stapel_courses.blocks.block_type_paths
  The effective block type registry (built-ins <- BLOCK_TYPES), type -> validator dotted path.
- strategy_names — stapel_courses.access.strategy_names
  The access names a course may carry; the author API refuses others with error.400.course_access_unknown.
- strategy_paths — stapel_courses.access.strategy_paths
  The effective access strategy registry (built-ins <- ACCESS_STRATEGIES), name -> dotted path.
### factory
- get_strategy — stapel_courses.access.get_strategy
  The strategy instance for a name; an unknown name gates like 'enrolled' (fail closed).
- validator — stapel_courses.blocks.validator
  The validator callable of a block type, or None when the type is not registered.

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- ACCESS_STRATEGIES [merge_registry]
  Access gate strategies by name, merged over free / enrolled / purchased / entitlement; a dotted path under a built-in name replaces it, None removes it. A strategy answers whether a learner may enroll themself (and with which source) and whether they see the content (with a lock reason).
- BLOCK_TYPES [merge_registry]
  Lesson content block validators by type, merged over text / video / attachment / embed. A validator takes the raw block dict and returns the cleaned dict to store or raises BlockInvalid.
- COMPLETION_RULE [strategy]
  Dotted path (enrollment) -> bool deciding completion after a lesson completion or a quiz pass; default: every required lesson completed and every required quiz passed.
- HOLDER_NAME_RESOLVER [strategy]
  Dotted path (user_id) -> str: the name printed on a certificate (default: the user's full name, else empty).
- STAPEL_COURSES_COURSE_PRESENTER / _ENROLLMENT_ / _LESSON_ / _QUIZ_ / _ATTEMPT_ / _CERTIFICATE_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the learner API presenters, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.
- courses.certificate.issued [comm_event]
  A certificate record was issued; its number is the public verification key.
- courses.course.completed [comm_event]
  A learner met the completion rule; emitted once per enrollment.
- courses.enrollment.activated [comm_event]
  A learner gained access (self-enrollment, entitlement, paid order, staff grant): enrollment, course, user, source, order, expiry.
- courses.purchasables [comm_function]
  The orders purchasable resolver for type 'course': {keys: [course id]} -> {id: {title, price, currency, available, max_quantity: 1, seller_id, image, url}}.
- orders.order.placed [comm_event]
  Consumed: course lines open a pending enrollment for the buyer; orders.order.paid (or .status_changed to confirmed, per PURCHASE_ACTIVATION) activates it; cancelled/refunded cancels the enrollment that order granted.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-auth (optional) — learners are request.user; a guest is a stapel-auth anonymous account, and user.merged moves a guest's enrollments, progress, attempts and certificates to the account on sign-in
- stapel-billing (optional) — answers billing.check_entitlement for courses with the 'entitlement' access mode (a plan includes the course)
- stapel-cdn (optional) — resolves the opaque media ids of cover images, video and attachment blocks (the frontend asks it; courses never does)
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (courses.* emits, purchasable/status/verify Functions, orders and user.merged consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings, swappable presenters
- stapel-notifications (optional) — delivers courses.enrollment_activated, courses.completed and courses.certificate_issued
- stapel-orders (optional) — sells courses: register purchasable type 'course' with resolver courses.purchasables (stapel_courses.preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS); orders.order.placed/paid/status_changed activate and cancel enrollments
- stapel-profiles (optional) — profiles.public_cards (CARDS_FUNCTION) names the learner on the author/staff enrollment, review and certificate lists; absent, those lists show user_id only

## Documented flows (5) — full steps in docs/flows.json
- courses.author — Build and run a course
- courses.learn — Take a course
- courses.purchase — Buy a course
- courses.quiz — Pass a quiz
- courses.verify — Verify a certificate
